notes: Two routes («وحدثني» starts the second) carry the same narrative: each ends at al-Ahnaf, the first-person narrator who saw the man
The speaker «قال لي خليلي» is unnamed in the text (the Prophet's words follow, and the Prophet is the end): a first-person narrative with an unnamed speaker, so the chain is not completed
«أبي» in the second route is a bare relation to Abd al-Samad
«أبي العلاء» (route one) and «أبو العلاء بن الشخير» (route two) are written differently and are not merged
